text:
cheng: Heads up — merged PR #7865 (burst allocator tweak) into main last night. Local canary shows p95 tail for longseq up ~30% vs baseline. Can we hold the full canary rollout until we confirm?

maria: @cheng can you paste the bench snapshot and which configs you ran?

cheng: pasted quick results below from bench-run-2026-03-15 (longseq, 8k tokens, batch=1):
```
baseline (main@before): p50=42ms p95=210ms p99=420ms mem=11.2GB
after PR7865:          p50=44ms p95=273ms p99=510ms mem=12.1GB
delta: p95 +63ms (~30%), mem +0.9GB
```
Link to dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/bench/7865-longseq (private)

aj: yikes. did you run with KV cache warm? the alloc path in that PR touched shard packing and burst allocator heuristics so could be transient.

cheng: yes KV cache warmed to 75% hit. Also saw a small uptick in allocator churn metrics: `alloc_reuse_rate` dropped ~8%. Logged traces: `traces/2468001234/`

sam: does this happen on other seq lengths (1k/2k)? or just longseq?

cheng: smaller seqs look fine (1k p95 within 3%); longseq profiling shows more frequent GC-like spikes in the allocator slab reclamation. Stack suggests `burst_allocator::steal_work` path executed more often.

leo: can you attach perf flame or `pprof`? I can follow the tracer. If it's allocator churn maybe revert fast or limit burst for longseq.

cheng: adding a flame extract (snippet):
```
# top stacks (longseq, after)
burst_allocator::alloc_step  34%
kv_cache::get             12%
attention::forward        8%
net::send                 6%
others                   40%
```

maria: ok pls open a quick revert PR or a canary hold flag. We should also block the 2nd stage canary. @ops-bot can you hold rollout? :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary hold requested by maria for release main@HEAD. Canary stage 1 paused. Reason: perf delta (p95 +30%). Ticket: INF-2026.

aj: I'll take a quick look at the allocator diff. If it's a heuristics regression we can gate the burst on sequence length or disable for >4k.

sam: can we run a targeted bench that toggles `burst_enabled=false` and compare? saves revert if toggle fixes it.

leo: I'll run that now on a dedicated nodepool and post numbers in ~30m. If it helps, I'll also capture `alloc_reuse_rate` and `slab_reclaim_count`.

cheng: thanks all. If @aj or @leo confirm a quick config change, i'll cut PR 7870 (config gate) and ping for two approvals. Otherwise i'll open a revert PR this afternoon.

maria: ack — @aj or @leo please ack when you have results. We prefer a config gate over revert if it's safe.

leo: quick update (30m): toggled burst_enabled=false on canary nodes. New numbers: p95=218ms mem=11.3GB. Back to baseline-ish.

leo: metrics: `alloc_reuse_rate` recovered to baseline, `slab_reclaim_count` dropped 60%. Looks like heuristics were too aggressive for long sequences.

aj: confirmed, patch changes heuristics threshold. I can review PR 7870 today. Please tag me when ready.

cheng: creating PR 7870 now (config gate + telemetry). Will ping for reviews. Thanks :thumbsup:

maria: perfect — hold canary until PR 7870 is merged and can be rolled as a config flag. Add a short note in the release notes.

ops-bot: Note: Canary remains paused. Reminder to run canary sanity after merge.
